## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: extreme single-sector breadth and narrow leadership with major megacap divergence (AAPL ABOVE TREND vs NVDA BELOW TREND) support a neutral, mixed market.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +18.23%) ABOVE TREND. Technology shows pockets of leadership—AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND—but the sector is not uniformly strong.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Healthcare lagging: UNH (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: SBUX (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -10.65% | 1M: -17.86%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND; QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND; ETN (1W: +7.11% | 1M: -7.52%) RECOVERY; META (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND; AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND; ADBE (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND; SHOP (1W: -11.72% | 1M: -14.37%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -8.97% | 1M: +6.07%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Healthcare and select high-multiple Tech.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND, ETN (1W: +7.11% | 1M: -7.52%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present (multiple large names show 1W vs 1M mismatch) — watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with narrow leadership and internal rotation; sector 1W: -0.21% (24 stocks). AAPL (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +9.93%) ABOVE TREND and AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND show strength while NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +0.84%) CORRECTION show meaningful divergence.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft and mixed; Financials 1W: -1.78% (20 stocks). JPM (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -2.45%) BELOW TREND sits with V (1W: -2.19% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION and MA (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +1.69%) CORRECTION — no clear sector leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive names failing to lead; Healthcare 1W: -5.60% (17 stocks). UNH (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -3.79% | 1M: -8.44%) BELOW TREND and JNJ (1W: -4.62% | 1M: +2.31%) CORRECTION reflect sector-wide weakness.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and select Technology winners showing confirmed momentum (XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to the weakest Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary names (NVS, AMGN, BKNG) while monitoring the large-cap tech divergences; style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: QCOM (+80) confirming price QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND; CVX (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND; ADBE (+50) but ADBE (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND — news positive but price diverging. BEARISH: AMGN (-50) AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND; NVS (-50) NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND; SYK (-45) SYK (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -20.64%) BELOW TREND — news and price aligned.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth: Energy positive; XOM ABOVE TREND, CVX ABOVE TREND) for relative strength. BEARISH: Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary (both deep 1W weakness) for downside risk and dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND — reclaiming a weekly pivot and holding it would be needed to signal a reversal. AAPL (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +9.93%) ABOVE TREND — sustained weekly closes keep the uptrend intact. AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND — follow-through above this week's high confirms momentum. XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND — a break below recent monthly support would warn of fading sector leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
QCOM (+80): Qualcomm headline and price confirm — QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment and price aligned. NVDA (+55): bullish AI supply narrative but NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price, watch for accumulation. CVX (+50): oil supply shock and price confirming — CVX (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMGN (-50): trial-related headline confirms weakness — AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND. NVS (-50): headline-driven weakness confirmed — NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND. SYK (-45): sales misses and price confirm — SYK (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -20.64%) BELOW TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; style mixed / no clear leadership. AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence across megacaps (NVDA BELOW TREND vs AMD ABOVE TREND) and several news-driven divergences (NVDA/ADBE headlines vs price) — monitor for confirmation before reallocating.
